To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
financial development fosters the growth in industries that are more financially dependent and that are more linked to other industries that are more in financial dependence.
financial development, in addition to promoting the growth of financially dependent industries, also favours the growth of industries linked to financially dependent industries.

financial development promotes the growth of industries that are more dependent on external finance and also those that are more strongly linked to more financially dependent upstream industries, and the indirect effect propagated by IO linkages has a significant impact on the growth of industries.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the role of financial development on growth and the way this effect is propagated through IO linkage in a panel of countries over the period 1985 2007.
a new channel through which financial development affects economic growth, and with the indirect effect of finance on growth.

In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the finance growth nexus is more complex than previously believed, and it is also more favourable to growth than previously thought.
the finance growth nexus is stronger than what is usually found and that the finance growth relation is not a simple one to one relationship.
finance matters for growth, especially when the latter is measured at the industry level.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

finance is a growth enhancing factor and that the growth of an industry is not only a function of its own financial dependence but it also depends on the financial dependence of its upstream suppliers and on the strength of the IO relations with them.
financial development is a key determinant of growth of industries across the world.
the finance growth nexus is not a simple one, but rather a complex web of relations.
The main takeaway from our work is that
IO linkages should be accounted for when assessing the finance growth nexus.
financial development has a strong impact not only on the growth of industries in need of external financing, but also on those that are indirectly linked to these industries.
the role of finance on growth cannot be fully grasped by focusing on its direct impact alone and that the finance growth nexus is more complex than it is commonly thought.
